OmaTasks now tells you when things are due. Your Todoist reminders, each task's time, upcoming deadlines, and a morning recap arrive as desktop notifications with Complete and Snooze buttons, and the bar names the task to do next.

![Notification settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.4.0/screenshots/notification-settings.png)

## New

- **Notifications for your tasks.** Reminders set in Todoist, before a task or at a fixed time, show as desktop notifications; urgent ones stay on screen until dismissed. A timed task is also announced at its time, even without a reminder, and can be switched off. Each notification has **Complete**, **Snooze 15 min**, and **Open** buttons. By @crmne.
- **A morning recap.** At 08:00, or the time you choose, one notification lists today's tasks in Smart order, how many are overdue, and deadlines in the next three days. If you are away or the computer is off at that time, it waits until you are back. By @crmne.
- **Deadline warnings.** A deadline tomorrow gets its own notification at recap time, and a deadline today gets one that stays on screen. By @crmne.
- **Reminders about overdue tasks, if you want them.** Off by default: choose every 1, 2, or 4 hours to hear again about a timed task still open on the day it was due. By @crmne.
- **Your next task in the bar.** The bar names a task starting soon or under way, then one you are late on, otherwise today's next timed task, as in "Review the homepage designs · at 10:00". On a narrow bar the name is shortened or left out, so it never runs into the clock. Choose **Today's count** or **Icon only** under **Settings → In the bar** for the previous look. By @crmne.

  ![The bar naming the next task](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.4.0/screenshots/bar.png)

- **Open the panel or Quick Add from a key.** `omarchy-shell crmne.todoist toggle` opens the panel on the focused monitor, or closes it; `show`, `hide`, `open`, and `close` also work, and `quickAdd` opens Quick Add. Bind them in Hyprland, for example `o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + T", "Tasks", "omarchy-shell crmne.todoist toggle")`. By @duff in [#20](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/20), with `show`, `hide`, and `quickAdd` by @crmne; thanks @seshna for [#1](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/1).
- **Larger text.** The panel, editors, menus, and settings use one size up throughout, matching the other Omarchy plugins next to them. By @crmne.

![Today panel and Quick Add](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.4.0/preview.png)

## Fixed

- **The panel follows your theme on Qt 6.12.** Qt 6.12 adds its own `Color` type, which hid Omarchy's palette from the plugin, so the panel and Quick Add fell back to Qt's light colors and dropdowns became hard to read. By @benmordecai in [#19](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/19).

## Known limitations

- Notifications come from the shell, so nothing is announced while you are logged out or the computer is off. Reminders that came due more than ten minutes before the shell saw them are not replayed; the morning recap still lists those tasks.
- Location reminders are left to Todoist's mobile apps.
- Snoozes are forgotten when the shell restarts.
- If Todoist's own apps also run on this computer, both may notify you.

## Validation

101 JavaScript tests, 24 composer UI checks, and 18 list interaction checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. The notification helper was run against the Omarchy notification server, and the panel commands were run in a live shell. Screenshots use synthetic tasks rendered from the real QML components on the GPU.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.
